evidence.note: Triangle of AI model, stacked Test environments and Automated scorer; only the model-to-environments arrow is drawn.
Three arrows from environments to scorer; the green one gets a check mark, the grey ones do not.
Green reward arrow returns to the model; callout text explains 'Aligned reinforcement'.
A red arrow also earns an identical check and a red reward arrow back to the model: the scorer cannot tell it apart, which is the core evidence for the proxy gap.
That the red path is a loophole/cheat is stated only in the callout and the left paragraph; the diagram has no label marking it as a cheat, and the two texts say the same thing.
Persistence in production models is added in prose only; the diagram does not change.
Insight overlay with the conclusion in text over the blurred slide.

rationale: The step-built loop shows a real part of the mechanism: an unlabelled red path earns the same check and reward as the legitimate green one. But what the red path means (a cheat that skips the task) and the consequence for production models are carried only by the callout and the left prose, which also repeat each other. That matches level 3: part of the evidence is visual, the rest is carried by prose.
